cohort: The study describes a 12-year-old girl with an interstitial 6q deletion and systematically reviews 28 previously described patients with overlapping deletions from the literature.
finding: A 12-year-old girl with a small interstitial 6q deletion (2 Mb circa) not encompassing the previously described 6q22 critical region presented with drug-resistant epilepsy, suggesting a potential additional locus (6q16.1-q21) for epilepsy development.
